Category: → Customer Intelligence / CRM Automation / Lead Scoring
Type: → System-Driven Automation (Batch / Scheduled)
Applies To: → Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Campaign Members

genAiPluginInstructions.description:
Use this topic when:
Your automation involves Engagement Score, behavioral triggers, or product usage indicators.
The purpose of the action is to highlight, flag, or route customers based on activity level.
You are surfacing high-touch Contacts or Leads for follow-up via:
Custom Apex Email
Prompt Builder drafts
Internal dashboards or queues

GenAiPlugin.scope:
The Engagement Intelligence topic refers to actions, prompts, or automations that are based on customer or lead activity signals, behavioral patterns, or engagement scores.
This topic is used to classify automation that surfaces high-intent individuals, helping internal users (Sales, Marketing, Service) to prioritize outreach, nudge decision-making, or trigger personalized communications.
Actions under this topic typically analyze:
Clicks, logins, session counts
Cart interactions
Email opens / campaign engagement
In-app behavior or survey responses
Custom engagement scores
These are proactive, insight-based systems to drive smart follow-up.
